game.title: Halo Infinite
game.blurb: Sci-fi first-person shooter with an open-world campaign on Zeta Halo and free-to-play multiplayer, from 343 Industries, released 2021-12-08. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The main missions, told as hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Difficulty, Skulls and Speed Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Normal, Heroic and Legendary, with all Skulls, and all 14 main missions in under eight hours.

chapters.title: Zeta Halo: Outposts, Bases and Targets
chapters.summary: Banished outposts, Forward Operating Bases, UNSC distress calls, High-Value Targets, Propaganda Towers, AA guns and Valor.

chapters.title: Collectibles and Spartan Upgrades
chapters.summary: Audio Logs, Spartan Cores, Mjolnir Armor Lockers, Forerunner Artifacts, hidden Skulls, and unlocking and upgrading equipment.

chapters.title: Campaign Feats and Mission Challenges
chapters.summary: Stunts in the open world and tough one-off challenges inside named missions.

chapters.title: Campaign Co-op
chapters.summary: Goals that need two or more players in the co-op campaign.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Matches
chapters.summary: Ranked play, custom games and medals or feats in matchmade games and modes. Needs a network connection.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Progress, Training and Customising
chapters.summary: The Tutorial, Training Mode and Weapon Drills, Battle Pass and challenges, theater, and customising your Spartan, AI, weapons and vehicles.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Halo Infinite" or "Halo: Infinite". halo.fandom.com answers the API under "Halo Infinite", with about 177 linked articles, including "Banished", "Escharum", "Big Team Battle", "Capture the Flag", "Attrition" and "Forge"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1240440 is "Halo Infinite" and holds both campaign and multiplayer achievements (144 in all). 18 are hidden: 17 sit at the top of the list and read like campaign missions, so they are in the campaign chapter; "Greased Lightning" sits between the Tutorial and the matchmade achievements and was put with multiplayer progress, which is a guess from position. RAWG's average playtime (2 hours) looks low for the campaign. Multiplayer chapters need a network connection.
